integrity: Formal generating-function argument establishes nonvanishing of every half-normal cumulant; finite independent arithmetic and geometric checks are supplementary. The inverse exponent is sharp at cubes but constants depend on dimension and compact side-length bounds.
scientific_limitations: Applies to orthotopes with positive side lengths and exact isotropic projected hyperplane volumes; no orientation, non-orthogonal parallelotope, or finite-sample statistical guarantee. Historical novelty remains subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Sharp finite-moment tomography of orthotopes in every dimension
